Work Product created in the course of the project is the property of Client throughout.
findings.explanation: This clause states that the work becomes the client's property immediately upon creation, meaning ownership transfers to the client before you have been fully paid.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until full payment of all amounts due under this Agreement has been received.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the contract. Before signing, I would like to propose a small adjustment to the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms indicate that ownership transfers immediately upon creation before full payment is made, so I would like to propose that ownership of the work product shall remain with the contractor until full payment of all amounts due under the agreement has been received. Best regards,
